metaData.originalTitle: 腾讯混元全新翻译模型 Hy-MT2 开源，小程序「腾讯 Hy 翻译」开放体验
metaData.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources New Translation Model Hy-MT2, Mini-Program 'Tencent Hy Translation' Now Available for Experience
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan open-sources its next-generation translation model Hy-MT2, supporting 33 languages. The 7B and 30B-A3B models achieve state-of-the-art open-source results, while the 1.8B model surpasses mainstream commercial APIs. A mini-program and app of the same name have also been launched.
metaData.summary: Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced its next-generation translation model, Hy-MT2, available in three sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B. All models support translation across 33 languages, as well as 5 minority languages and dialects. The model demonstrates excellent performance in general translation, specialized domain translation, and real-world business scenarios. The 7B and 30B-A3B models surpass open-source models like DeepSeek-V4-Pro in multiple evaluations, approaching the level of Gemini 3.1 Pro. Hy-MT2 introduces a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture for the first time and achieves extreme 1.25-bit quantization based on the proprietary Sherry framework. The 1.8B model requires only 440MB of storage, enabling local inference on mobile phone chips with a 1.5x speed improvement over the previous generation. Concurrently, the 'Tencent Hy Translation' mini-program based on Hy-MT2 has been launched, supporting voice input, customizable translation styles, and offline translation.

mainPoints.point: The Hy-MT2 series achieves state-of-the-art open-source results on general and specialized translation tasks, approaching the level of closed-source top-tier models.
mainPoints.explanation: In evaluations like FLORES-200 and DomainMTBench, the 7B and 30B-A3B models achieve GEMBA scores of 96%-99% compared to Gemini 3.1 Pro, and even surpass it in vertical domains such as finance and politics.

mainPoints.point: It introduces the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture for the first time, achieving a better balance between effectiveness and efficiency.
mainPoints.explanation: The 30B-A3B model increases total parameters to enhance capacity while controlling activated parameters to reduce inference overhead, making it more suitable for high-quality translation systems in real-world applications.

mainPoints.point: Based on the proprietary Sherry framework, it achieves extreme 1.25-bit quantization, allowing the 1.8B model to be deployed with only 440MB.
mainPoints.explanation: The extremely low-bit quantized version can perform local inference on mobile chips like the Apple A15, with a 1.5x speed improvement over the previous 4-bit version, solving storage and latency bottlenecks for on-device deployment.

mainPoints.point: Translation instruction-following capability is significantly improved, and the accompanying test set IFMTBench has been open-sourced.
mainPoints.explanation: The model can accurately understand and execute user-specific requirements regarding terminology, style, and output format. The IFMTBench, a test set for translation instruction following, has been open-sourced alongside the model.

keyQuotes: Hy-MT2 is a multilingual model supporting translation across 33 languages. The 7B and 30B-A3B models achieve the best results among open-source models on various translation tasks, surpassing models with tens of times more parameters.
The lightweight 1.8B model also surpasses mainstream commercial APIs like Microsoft's, and thanks to AngelSlim's extreme 1.25-bit quantization, it requires only 440MB of storage.
Hy-MT2 is not merely a simple scale-up of Hy-MT1.5, but a systematic upgrade centered around real-world feedback.

relatedArticles.title: A New Paradigm! Tencent Hunyuan Proposes HY-WU (Weight Unleashing), Enabling Real-time Parameter Generation for Model 'Brain Swapping'
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan proposes the HY-WU (Weight Unleashing) paradigm, which replaces static weights with real-time generated dynamic parameters to solve the challenges of 'catastrophic forgetting' and 'performance balancing' in large model personalization.

relatedArticles.title: Essential for Travel! Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Offline Translation Model for Mobile, Only 0.4GB, Supporting 33 Languages
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced an extremely quantized offline translation model for mobile, Hy-MT1.5-1.8B. Using 2-bit and 1.25-bit compression techniques, the model size is reduced to 440MB, supporting offline translation in 33 languages with quality surpassing Google Translate.

relatedArticles.title: Breaking the Zero-Shot TTS Voice Cloning Limit: The Art of Voice Cloning with LongCat-AudioDiT
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Meituan's LongCat team has open-sourced LongCat-AudioDiT, a zero-shot voice cloning model that performs end-to-end generation directly in the waveform latent space. By addressing the training-inference mismatch and introducing Adaptive Projection Guidance, it achieves state-of-the-art speaker similarity on the Seed benchmark.

relatedArticles.title: Kimi K2.6 Released and Open-Sourced, Significantly Advancing Code and Agent Cluster Capabilities
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI has released and open-sourced the Kimi K2.6 model, achieving significant improvements in code capabilities, long-horizon task execution, and Agent cluster collaboration, and announced the start of the Claw Group internal beta.

relatedArticles.title: Tencent Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 Released: Seamless Integration with Game Workflows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced its 3D world model HY-World 2.0. This model can generate editable 3D assets with physical collision from text, image, or video input in one click, and seamlessly import them into game engines like Unity/UE, significantly lowering the barrier for creating game maps and level prototypes.

relatedArticles.title: Hunyuan Embodied-0.5 Open Source: Designed for Real-World Embodied Agents, a New Foundation for Physical Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent's Hunyuan team has open-sourced the HY-Embodied-0.5 model series, which significantly enhances edge-side model capabilities in 3D spatial perception and physical planning through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and large-scale embodied data.

relatedArticles.title: Hy3 Preview Sees 10x Token Growth in Two Weeks Since Launch
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan's Hy3 Preview model has achieved a 10x increase in token consumption compared to its predecessor within two weeks of launch, securing first place on the OpenRouter weekly leaderboard with 3.66 trillion tokens, with particularly strong growth in code and agent scenarios.

relatedArticles.title: Making LLMs Understand 3,000 Years of Chinese Characters: Chronicles-OCR, a Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Character Recognition, Released
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan, in collaboration with multiple institutions, released Chronicles-OCR, the industry's first benchmark for ancient Chinese character recognition covering seven scripts from oracle bone script to cursive script. Evaluating 28 mainstream multimodal large models, it found that even the strongest models nearly failed entirely at ancient character recognition, revealing that modern VLLMs heavily rely on modern layout priors and lack fine-grained stroke perception capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek V4 Report Is Incredibly Detailed! The Full Story of the 484-Day Upgrade Journey
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek officially released the V4 series of models, achieving a KV cache of only 10% of V3.2 under a million-token context through the mHC architecture, hybrid attention mechanism, and Muon optimizer, while being fully open-source and supporting domestic chips.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek-V4 Preview: Ushering in the Era of Million-Token Context for Everyone
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek releases the V4 preview, offering Pro and Flash versions with million-token context as standard, achieving open-source leadership in Agent, reasoning, and knowledge capabilities, and open-sourcing the model simultaneously.
